evidence_scope_note: This is a distinct predeclared feature family evaluated on the already observed 401..1250 historical sample. It is not an independent prospective sample and cannot count as prospective confirmation.
hypothesis: For each candidate number, the count of previous-draw main numbers sharing its terminal digit may provide cutoff-safe information about next-draw inclusion. One fixed shrinkage estimator may improve a deterministic three-line disjoint union18 portfolio over the exact geometry-matched null.

feature_definition.source: The immediately preceding draw's six main numbers only; bonus is excluded.
feature_definition.class: For candidate n, terminal-digit class d=n mod 10; state k is the count of previous-draw main numbers with the same terminal digit.
feature_definition.state_range: k is an integer from 0 through 6; terminal-digit classes are 0..9; class 0 contains four numbers and classes 1..9 contain five numbers.
feature_definition.candidate_universe: All integers 1..45 are scored for every target.
feature_definition.transition_history: For each historical outcome round u=2..t-1, use the terminal-digit occupancy of draw u-1 as the feature and main-number inclusion in draw u as the outcome. Score target t from draw t-1, then add target t only after scoring.

training_cutoff_rule: For target t, use only draws 1..t-1. Historical transitions u=2..t-1 use the terminal-digit occupancy of draw u-1 and the main-number outcome in draw u. Score target t using draw t-1 and outcomes through t-1 only; add target draw t after scoring.

estimator.prior_mean: 6/45 main-number inclusion probability under the uniform 6-of-45 null

portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.
portfolio.selection: Three sequential calls to the unchanged E045 choose_disjoint_ticket selector, passing the E063 score as both role_score and global_score; remove selected numbers after each line.

random_comparator.method: For each target, uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line-incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null.

prospective_confirmation.readiness_rule: Even if the historical gate passes, do not create STRICT_PASS_READY or release purchase lines until the policy owner formally predeclares the prospective minimum target count and completion rule.

promotion_rule: Evaluate this single preregistered axis once. No variants, threshold changes, alpha changes, block-length changes, comparator changes, or parameter search after observing results. Historical failure remains failure. Historical pass alone cannot create purchase readiness because prospective confirmation is required and currently unspecified.
